fact: In early October 2024 the BFM instructed all CSBF-licensed institutions, including banks and e-money institutions, to join the Instant Payment System it set up and manages, a component of the planned national switch, with connection deadlines of 31 January 2025 (banks, EMIs) and 31 July 2025 (large MFIs).
title: Adhésion obligatoire au « système de paiement instantané » de la banque centrale pour les institutions financières
